instagram.required_for_test: Owner changes the profile website to the Instagram-specific tracked URL immediately before the test window, then restores/updates it deliberately afterward.
instagram.attribution_limit: Profile link is shared across posts; tagged DUFYND sessions are source/campaign/content labeled but cannot prove which Instagram post caused every profile click.

tiktok.required_for_test: Owner verifies the website link exists and sets it to the TikTok-specific tracked URL before publishing.
tiktok.attribution_limit: Profile link is shared across posts; platform video_website_clicks may help but null is not zero and first-party sessions remain the source of truth for DUFYND traffic.

youtube.required_for_test: Use the YouTube channel profile link for the tracked URL. A normal URL in a Shorts description is not clickable.
youtube.attribution_limit: Channel profile link is shared across Shorts; do not describe attributed profile traffic as exact per-video causality without a dedicated click surface.

pre_publish_checks: Exact product is Rabanne 1 Million Eau de Toilette 100 ml; no Parfum/Elixir/50 ml substitution.
Existing approved product visual/master is used without identity-changing edits.
Perfumetrader exact 100 ml current price/stock evidence is still within the 72-hour offer freshness window at publish time.
Existing Awin affiliate route still points to advertiser 11672, exact merchant product 16978322, and clickref one_million_example61_01.
No cheapest/best-price claim; recheck current comparable non-affiliate offers before any future price claim.
All src/cmp/content identifiers are unchanged and within the storefront allowlist/identifier contract.
Platform link destination is the platform-specific tracked DUFYND product URL, not a generic homepage.
Caption contains no unsupported performance, sales or price claim.
Audio is cleared on the actual target platform at upload time.
Mobile preview: hook readable in first second; subtitles safe-area checked; no text hidden by UI.
Owner gives explicit publish approval for the frozen asset/copy/link package.
post_publish_qa: Record platform content ID and public URL.
Confirm published caption/title matches approved package.
Open the actual profile/channel link in a clean session and confirm src/cmp/content survive the DUFYND landing.
Confirm fragrance_detail_view is recorded for SC-RABANNE-1-MILLION-EDT-100.
Confirm offer_section_view/open can be recorded without synthetic merchant clickout.
Do not generate artificial merchant clickouts or purchases.
After real traffic arrives, reconcile platform views with attributed DUFYND sessions.
Keep clickout, network transaction and commission as separate funnel stages.

prior_creative.learning: Looping/view completion was stronger on YouTube than active interaction. P1 keeps the recognizable product but replaces the generic iconic/overrated binary with a more specific 2026 social-identity tension and explicit comment choice.

success_metrics.content_views: Platform-native views for the exact published content ID. Never deduplicate across platforms.
success_metrics.link_ctr: For profile-link platforms, report tracked DUFYND landing sessions / content views as a profile-to-site transfer proxy, not a strict per-post click CTR. If a platform supplies an exact website-click metric, report it separately.
success_metrics.dufynd_sessions: Unique first-party session_key values carrying the exact source, campaign_id and content_id.
success_metrics.product_detail_views: Unique attributed sessions with fragrance_detail_view for SC-RABANNE-1-MILLION-EDT-100.
success_metrics.offer_opens: Unique attributed sessions with offer_section_open; report offer_section_view separately as exposure.
success_metrics.merchant_clickouts: Unique attributed sessions with merchant_clickout after product/offer engagement.
success_metrics.clickout_rate: merchant_clickout_sessions / qualified attributed product_detail_sessions. Also report landing_to_clickout separately.
success_metrics.network_transactions: Unique Awin transaction IDs matched to the DUFYND clickref where network evidence exists; retain pending/approved/declined status.
success_metrics.commission: Network-reported commission, deduplicated by transaction ID and latest amendment/validation state. Pending, approved and paid/settled amounts remain separate.
success_metrics.revenue_per_1000_qualified_visits: approved_or_paid_commission_eur / qualified_product_detail_sessions * 1000, using one declared commission state consistently.
success_metrics.revenue_per_content_piece: approved_or_paid commission matched to the content clickref/campaign evidence. Never substitute merchant clickouts.
success_metrics.forbidden_interpretation: Merchant clickout is not a sale.

quick_cro.requirement: TECH: for SC-RABANNE-1-MILLION-EDT-100 merchant offer CTA ready and preparing states, enforce min-height >=44px and centered content below 640px. Do not alter copy, offer ranking, destination or tracking.
quick_cro.measurement: qualified merchant clickout sessions / attributed product detail sessions before vs after in fixed windows; descriptive unless randomized.

quick_cro.current_state: FragranceOffers already shows total price when calculable, shipping labels, freshness timestamp and affiliate disclosure.
quick_cro.requirement: Do not add marketing copy. Keep total-price-first ordering and never hide a fresher cheaper non-affiliate option. Stale offers must stay excluded rather than shown as current.

quick_cro.current_state: Direct product path already supports src/cmp/content session attribution.
quick_cro.requirement: Use platform-specific tracked product URL as the profile/channel destination during the approved test window; do not route to homepage or generic finder.
quick_cro.measurement: tracked DUFYND sessions / platform views, with shared-profile-link causality caveat.

required_join_chain: latest validated transaction state -> approved_or_paid commission

reconciliation_rules: Never create synthetic orders or clicks.
Deduplicate by stable network transaction ID.
Keep initial transaction, validation and amendment/correction history; report the latest authoritative state.
Do not sum pending and approved versions of the same transaction.
Keep order value separate from DUFYND commission.
A network transaction matched by clickref supports network attribution; first-party session causality remains a separate evidence layer.
Revenue remains null until a real network transaction exists.

owner_gates: Explicit approval of the frozen 1 Million asset/script/caption/link package before publishing.
For cleanest source attribution, approve changing each platform profile/channel link to its platform-specific tracked product URL for the test window.
For real Awin revenue reconciliation, confirm authoritative Awin publisher/account ID and connect/provide API credentials through a secure provider form; never paste secrets into chat.
